featured_reviews.name: VD S
featured_reviews.review_text:
Jayesh Mehta - Age 63 years

I cannot thank the team here enough for the incredible care they provided to my father. From the clean, spacious rooms to the remarkably hospitable staff, we felt well taken care of.

I want to specifically thank RN Tejaswini Patil on the 10th floor. Her kindness and support went above and beyond; she treated my father like her own family.

We also had a great experience with Dr. Bhadresh Dedhia, who was incredibly helpful in keeping my father comfortable and explained every necessary procedure and every diagnosis to us with utmost patience everyday.
Dr. Jatin Kothari, who is truly one of the best nephrologists we have encountered also meticulously supervised my fathers care while he was admitted. Always quick to respond to our queries, even when he is out of office and has a GREAT team supporting my father’s renal procedures.
Dr Kayan Sisodia supervised my dad’s cardiac procedures and had also earlier performed my dad’s angiography a few years ago. He is one of the finest cardiac doctors and above that, an extremely humble human being. He makes you feel completely at ease the minute you speak to him.

Although the admin and TPA desk seemed a bit understaffed and could be improved, it did not take away from the phenomenal medical treatment my father received. Namrata from the TPA department ensured all my queries were taken care of. Grateful to the whole team for everything.

featured_reviews.name: Lavanya Anand
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had a small day procedure that took me to Hinduja Khar & I must say I came out of the whole experience feeling like I wasn't a patient but a client of the hospital.

The hospital is efficient, clean & extremely easy to navigate but it's the staff that makes the place world class. Everyone from the team that took care of admissions, the day charge staff, the post surgery staff to the discharge staff were kind, gentle, courteous & efficient. They understand that everyone who comes to a hospital is stressed but they all made me feel so at ease that  I felt completely at ease & confident that the staff was right with me every step of the way.

I especially want to highlight the amazing day care staff- Vidya, Namrat, Aarti, Swapnil & Krutika. Dr. Sofiya who took all my readings and the helps- Sakshi & Meenakshi Maushi who ensured they were around when I needed anything . The anaesthesiologists  - Dr. Christine & Dr. Shubam were so gentle & careful with the whole administration that I think I recovered faster due to that.

Its odd to recommend a hospital but I would highly recommend PD Hinduja Khar for their attention to detail & patient care. Oh, Also, the food in the day care unit was incredible. Another added bonus I say.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Long Post Alert!

Women's Hospital "Room Harmony" has been etched in my memory as it  was my home for two and a half months.
I had a complicated pregnancy and was advised completed bed rest and was admitted under Dr. Gayatri Rao's guidance who turned my hope into reality. She is the sweetest soul who would brighten my dark days with her encouraging words and smile.
On April 2nd, I delivered a premature baby boy after the long tiring journey.
I would also like to thank the nurses who had made my stay homely with utmost care and positivity. They were nice to me and somehow became my friends by the time I was leaving.
A big shoutout to sisters - Vidya, Hema, Trishala, Smita, Mayuri, Namrata, Alpa, Yashika, Sunita and I might have missed few other names but I am equally grateful to each.

Not only the nurses even the maushis were accomodating everytime I had to use the loo as I was on complete bed rest.

Last but not the least, I would also love to mention few other doctors who helped me with the littlest difficulty, doubt, concern even during the middle of the night namely Dr. Dipali, Dr. Vijaya, Dr. Shalini, Dr. Surti and Dr. Dolly.

Dr. Dipali was very empathetic soul who would keep visiting my room and appreciating and encouraging me to overcome each day in the hospital. Dr. Vijaya would flawlessly put the IV drip's on me with most care and concern avoiding any chances of hurting me. Also, Dr. Manju sinha would keep visiting and advising me to read books for a positivity.

Another appreciation I would want to give the phlebotomist who would come for my blood tests and would tell me lovingly that I would be a good mom. I forgot her name but I hope you guys will find out who she is.

It was a tumultuous journey for both me and my husband, but the way Dr. Gayatri Rao made my pregnancy possible with her positive smile and golden words is beyond everything.

It was a long stay but it became bearable with each and every person mentioned above. Thank you guys, for helping me out during the most fragile yet memorable time of my life. I will always be indebted to this hospital.

The only drawback if I may mention are the charges of the hospital as it is located at the posh side of bandra khar. But, for middle class people like us the charges were indeed challenging.

featured_reviews.review_text:
The hospital is located on the main road, which makes it easy to find. However, parking is a challenge as there is limited space available for both 2-wheelers and 4-wheelers.

featured_reviews.name: Cherish Fernandes
featured_reviews.review_text:
There are some people in life whom you can never thank enough, and for us, Dr. Nand Kishor Kabra and the entire NICU team at Surya Hospital will always be among them.

As parents of an extremely premature baby born at just 28 weeks and weighing barely 1 kg, we entered the NICU with fear, uncertainty, and shattered hearts. Those days were the most emotionally difficult days of our lives. But from the very beginning, Dr. Kabra gave us something priceless — hope.

His calmness, knowledge, confidence, and years of expertise in neonatology made us feel that our tiny baby was in the safest hands possible. Every decision was explained with patience, every setback was handled with immense care, and every tiny milestone was celebrated with us. What truly sets Dr. Kabra apart is not just his brilliance as a neonatologist, but the compassion and humanity with which he treats both babies and parents.

Today, seeing our little Ashriel growing, smiling, vocalizing, and filling our home with life feels nothing short of a miracle, and we know a huge part of that miracle belongs to Dr. Kabra and the wonderful NICU team at Surya Hospital.

We will forever remain grateful to Surya Hospital for giving our tiny fighter the best possible start to life. Thank you for your dedication, your kindness, and for standing beside families during their most vulnerable moments. You don’t just treat babies — you save dreams, families, and futures.

Forever grateful.

Overall, it was truly one of the best experiences I could have hoped for. I would highly recommend my gynecologist to anyone looking for compassionate, skilled, and trustworthy care.

I would also like to add that even after my delivery, she was in constant touch with me, asking if I am okay and if there is any concern. I am truly grateful that I found her as my gynaecologist and experience the best delivery any women could wish for. Thank you Dr. Anju.

featured_reviews.review_text:
I came to Dr. Manjiri just three weeks before my due date — a last-minute switch from my original doctor who had to travel during my birth.

I went past my due date and she agreed to wait patiently for spontaneous labour. On the day, she arrived at the hospital before we even did, and during active labour she was a quiet, steady presence in the room — making a suggestion or providing guidance only when it truly mattered.

And when I pushed my baby, her calm and capable hands were right there doing what needed to be done. My son arrived safely, and after the birth, she became a completely different energy — peaceful and calm, entirely focused on that first bond between mother and child. It felt less like a delivery room and more like a sacred space.

In a world where obstetric care has become increasingly intervention-driven — where the default is to hurry, to medicate, to manage — Dr. Manjirir has taken the road less travelled. She understands that birth, when supported rather than controlled, has its own intelligence. It is not a popular choice in today's medical landscape, and I imagine it takes real conviction to hold that line. But she does. Quietly, consistently, without fanfare.

I had an unmedicated water birth, overdue, with a cord around my baby, and yet I walked away feeling like my body had been trusted and my birth had been honoured. That is an extraordinary thing to be able to say.

If you are looking for a doctor who will hold space for the birth you hope for — rather than the one that's most convenient — Dr. Manjiri is who you want in that room.
